# Standard mileage rate or actual expenses in 2026?

> Free calculator comparing the 2026 IRS standard mileage rate (72.5 cents per mile through June 30, 76 cents from July 1) with actual vehicle expenses for a self-employed business car. See which deduction is larger and what it is worth. Entirely client-side, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
